Return window: EU/UK customers have a 14-day statutory withdrawal right; all customers have a 30-day voluntary return period from receipt. Items must be unused, complete, and in original packaging.
How to return: Register your return via our Return Portal first, then return with:
A prepaid label from us (fee may be deducted from your refund, depending on country),
A carrier of your choice at your own cost, or
Free in-person return at our Flagship Stores (for online orders only).
Refunds: Once your return arrives and is inspected, we refund to the original payment method within up to 8 business days. If you return your full order, we also refund the cost of the cheapest standard shipping; if you keep at least one item, original shipping costs are not refunded.
Return fees: If you use our prepaid label, a flat return shipping fee may be deducted from your refund (varies by country). If you organize shipping yourself, we don’t charge return shipping costs.
Conditions & deductions: If an item was used beyond what’s necessary to inspect it, we may deduct a depreciation amount from your refund. Partial refunds can also be affected if discount conditions are no longer met or if multiple packages are returned separately.
Late returns: After 30 days, we may make individual exceptions only for completely unused items in original packaging.
Defective products: If you return a defective product, we cover the full return shipping costs after reviewing your case.
